description: Main heating fuel and whether it is supplied through a community scheme.

biodiesel (any biomass): heat from boilers using biodiesel from any biomass source (community)
biodiesel (used cooking oil): biodiesel from used cooking oil only
biodiesel (vegetable oil): biodiesel from vegetable oil only (not community)
biomass: community heating schemes: heat from boilers - biomass
dual fuel (mineral and wood): solid fuel: dual fuel appliance (mineral and wood)
heat pump: community heating schemes: heat from electric heat pump
community heating schemes: heat from heat pump
mains gas: community heating schemes: heat from mains gas
mineral oil or liquid biofuel: appliances able to use mineral oil or liquid biofuel
heat from boilers that can use mineral oil or biodiesel (community)
no heating or hot water system: to be used only when there is no heating/hot-water system
no system or community network: to be used only when there is no heating/hot-water system or data is from a community network
no heating/hot-water system or data is from a community network
waste combustion: waste combustion - this is for backwards compatibility only and should not be used
waste heat from power stations: community heating schemes: waste heat from power stations
wood pellets (bags): wood pellets in bags for secondary heating
solid fuel: wood pellets (in bags, for secondary heating)
wood pellets (bulk): solid fuel: wood pellets (bulk supply in bags, for main heating)

community.description: True for a community (heat network) supply, false if stated as not community.

true: community heating schemes: heat from mains gas
community heating schemes: heat from boilers - biomass
community heating schemes: waste heat from power stations
community heating schemes: heat from electric heat pump
community heating schemes: heat from heat pump
heat from boilers using biodiesel from any biomass source (community)
heat from boilers that can use mineral oil or biodiesel (community)
false: biodiesel from vegetable oil only (not community)
